SitePartDef.label: Replicator-consumed ruin
SitePartDef.description: A stripped ruin contaminated by autonomous block Replicators and loose self-organizing Replicator blocks. The site is an early physical source of Replicator material, but exposed salvage can reconstruct itself.
SitePartDef.arrivedLetter: The ruin has been stripped almost bare. Two active Replicator Drones remain among loose Replicator blocks. Uncontained stacks of ten or more blocks can reconstruct new Drones after sufficient exposure.
